title: AssertionError: The 'data' field must be of type 'float' in rclpy: Humble asserts, Jazzy and Lyrical abort at publish, measured
excerpt: Why int, numpy.float32, time.time() and rclpy Duration fail in ROS 2 message fields, why Jazzy and Lyrical skip the check unless ROS_PYTHON_CHECK_FIELDS=1 and then abort in convert_from_py, which wrong values wrap silently, and numpy array fixes timed on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
